title: Unlock 🔓 3 Free APIs to Access Thousands of Powerful AI Models for Text, Image & More!
description: First, check out Bytez, the largest inference API online, providing access to over 1,000 open-source AI models through a single API key. Next, NVIDIA offers access to top-tier models with a generous rate limit of 40 requests per minute, perfect for most projects. Lastly, OpenRouter gives you free API keys for advanced open-source models like Kimi, supporting serious development with solid rate limits. Plus, I’ll share a handy free GitHub repository that lists all these API providers in one place, so you can easily integrate these services into your development environment. Don’t forget to subscribe and turn on notifications for more AI tips and resources! Keywords: AI models, free AI APIs, Bytez, NVIDIA AI, OpenRouter, open-source AI, AI development, AI tools free, artificial intelligence, AI resources
